modeled_features: Pale veined counter with curved eastern return
Three rear niches with actual clipped fluted-concrete surface
Open-backed curved brass mesh espresso screens with physical holes
Generic two-urn coffee brewer, frozen beverage dispenser, espresso machine and POS hardware
Two-tier glass pastry case with original donut meshes
Generic unbranded retail packs, mugs and chilled drinks
Visible service door closed at documented threshold
Clear-glazed entry/frontage and observed text signage
Capsule wall lamps and recessed ceiling lights
assumptions_and_gaps: No concealed kitchen, storage, utility runs, equipment schedule or adjacent private tenant layouts
Front opening top 4.30 m, lowered bar ceiling 3.18 m and counter top 1.10 m are proportion assumptions
Perforation LOD uses 60 mm pitch and 36 mm holes, not measured shop drawings
Curved stone silhouette and niche radii are mesh approximations from views, not exact fabrication profiles
Lighting intensities are interpretive; original authored PBR textures represent material class and are not site scans
Equipment is visually recognizable but unbranded and does not claim exact models or current stock
Reported seating for six is not instantiated because the inspected photographs do not establish stool geometry or positions
Rooster neon emblem and pricing are omitted rather than inaccurately traced or invented
Architect photo08 shows salvaged stone before installation and is not treated as a completed-room view
An undimensioned published HNS scope drawing supports an L-shaped rear/service extension. It does not establish a measured current as-built suite plan, and unseen fit-out remains omitted.
Registered shell covers48.246m2 while published full suite area is59.458m2; the known rearL service footprint remains unfit-out. Raster areas are not forced to match lease area.
Additional east strip and rear ceiling margin use plain provisional shell closures; no invented furniture, equipment or internal partition added
Menu lettering follows the newly registered outer east wall; resulting larger separation from counter is an explicit plan-versus-photo spatial interpretation
